sloka: शिबिकाभिः च यानैः च यथा अर्हम् तस्य योषितः ।नगरान् निर्ययुस् तत्र वृद्धैः परिवृताः तदा ॥२-७६-१९॥
transliteration: śibikābhiḥ ca yānaiḥ ca yathā arham tasya yoṣitaḥ ।nagarān niryayus tatra vṛddhaiḥ parivṛtāḥ tadā ॥2-76-19॥

translations.english: Then in accordance with their rank and surrounded by aged guards, the wives of king Dasaratha departed for that place from the city in palanquins and other carriages.
